Tier_A_requirement: All critical identity, assay-family, arm, calibration, unit, and interference criteria pass; remaining variation is demonstrably bridgeable
Tier_B_requirement: Core ORAC-FL identity, arm, Trolox reference, and molar conversion pass; only noncritical details are missing or explainably different
Tier_C_condition: A known nonbridgeable incompatibility or material interference is present
Tier_X_condition: ORAC is reported but available methods do not permit A/B/C assignment
exclusion_reason: C records are excluded from formal numerical ranking; X records are held pending information retrieval
rationale: Overall tier follows the weakest critical criterion rather than a count of passed fields
example: A complete AAPH-fluorescein-Trolox H-ORAC study is A; a food ORAC value is C

Tier_A_requirement: Unique compound name and structure identifier are verified
Tier_B_requirement: Identity is unambiguous but one registry identifier is absent
Tier_C_condition: Mixture, extract, food, or unresolved isomer is reported
Tier_X_condition: Name is given but the exact chemical entity cannot be resolved
rationale: Molar ranking requires a unique chemical entity
example: Quercetin aglycone is eligible; onion extract is C

Tier_A_requirement: Stereochemistry, isomer, salt, hydrate, and oxidation state are stated where relevant
Tier_B_requirement: Form is strongly inferable and does not materially alter molar conversion
Tier_C_condition: Known forms are pooled despite different molecular weights or reactivity
Tier_X_condition: Form is not reported and cannot be inferred
rationale: Form affects molecular weight, solubility, and reactivity

Tier_A_requirement: Purity is reported and adequate for quantitative single-compound testing, normally >=95%, or a certified standard is used
Tier_B_requirement: Purity is reported but slightly below the preferred threshold with impurity risk judged minor
Tier_C_condition: Material impurity, degradation, or mixture can materially bias the value
Tier_X_condition: Purity is unreported and no supplier/certificate information is recoverable
rationale: An antioxidant impurity can inflate capacity per nominal mole

Tier_B_requirement: ORAC-FL is clear from reagents or cited protocol although the label is abbreviated
Tier_C_condition: A non-FL probe or materially different ORAC variant is used without validated bridging
rationale: Probe chemistry and decay behavior change the construct
example: Beta-phycoerythrin ORAC is C for an ORAC-FL ranking

Tier_A_requirement: H-ORAC or L-ORAC is explicit and retained as a separate arm
Tier_B_requirement: Arm is reliably inferred from solvent and protocol
Tier_C_condition: H- and L-ORAC are pooled or compared as one scale without validation
Tier_X_condition: Solvent information is insufficient to assign an arm
rationale: Hydrophilic and lipophilic protocols are not inherently commutable
example: RMCD-based assay is recorded as L-ORAC

Tier_A_requirement: AAPH is stated with concentration or a fully traceable locked protocol
Tier_B_requirement: AAPH is confirmed but concentration is missing
Tier_C_condition: A different radical generator is used without bridging validation
rationale: Radical flux and identity govern kinetic response
example: AAPH-derived peroxyl radicals pass; hydroxyl-radical assay is C

Tier_A_requirement: Fluorescein and its concentration are reported or fixed by a traceable protocol
Tier_B_requirement: Fluorescein is confirmed but concentration is missing
Tier_C_condition: Another probe is used without equivalence validation
rationale: Probe stability and reaction kinetics affect AUC

Tier_A_requirement: Trolox calibration and curve use are explicit
Tier_B_requirement: Trolox is confirmed but calibration details are incomplete
Tier_C_condition: A different standard is used and no validated conversion to Trolox exists
rationale: A common calibrant is required for TE expression
example: Trolox curve passes; ascorbate equivalents without bridge are C

Tier_A_requirement: Buffer composition, ionic strength where relevant, and pH are reported and compatible with the target protocol
Tier_B_requirement: pH or full buffer composition is missing but cited protocol and context support comparability
Tier_C_condition: Known pH or buffer difference materially changes ionization or kinetics without bridging
Tier_X_condition: Buffer and pH are both unavailable
rationale: Ionization and radical-transfer kinetics are pH dependent

Tier_A_requirement: Temperature is reported and matches the protocol window
Tier_B_requirement: Temperature is omitted but instrument/protocol citation makes 37 C highly likely
Tier_C_condition: Known temperature is outside the compatible window without correction
rationale: AAPH radical generation and reaction rates are temperature dependent
example: 37 C passes; room-temperature endpoint does not

Tier_A_requirement: Solvent, cosolvent, detergent, and RMCD identity/concentration are fully reported
Tier_B_requirement: Main solvent system is known but a minor proportion is missing
Tier_C_condition: Known solvent or solubilizer causes an unbridged arm or reactivity difference
rationale: Solvent controls dissolution, aggregation, and radical access

Tier_A_requirement: Reading interval and total duration are reported and capture the decay curve
Tier_B_requirement: One schedule element is absent but complete-curve AUC is evident
Tier_C_condition: Truncated or endpoint-only acquisition is used as ORAC without validated equivalence
Tier_X_condition: Both interval and duration are unavailable

Tier_A_requirement: Blank correction, integration rule, and net-AUC logic are stated or exactly traceable
Tier_B_requirement: Net AUC is reported but integration details are incomplete
Tier_C_condition: A noncomparable endpoint or undocumented transformed score is used
Tier_X_condition: It is unclear whether AUC was calculated
rationale: Different integration and blank rules change TE estimates

Tier_A_requirement: Multiple concentrations establish linearity and fall within the Trolox calibration range
Tier_B_requirement: A suitable concentration range is shown but formal linearity statistics are absent
Tier_C_condition: Only a saturated, nonmonotonic, or single out-of-range concentration is used
Tier_X_condition: Concentrations or linearity cannot be assessed
rationale: Molar TE conversion assumes proportional response
example: At least three concentrations with linear response

Tier_A_requirement: Original value and unit are available and conversion to mol TE/mol is fully reproducible
Tier_B_requirement: Molar TE/mol is directly reported but intermediate calculation details are incomplete
Tier_C_condition: Food-level, extract-level, mass-only, or ambiguous units cannot be validly converted
Tier_X_condition: Value is mentioned without a recoverable unit or denominator
rationale: Cross-molecular-weight comparison requires a molar basis
example: umol TE/umol compound equals mol TE/mol

Tier_A_requirement: Compound blanks, spectral checks, recovery, or other appropriate controls exclude relevant interference
Tier_B_requirement: No specific interference is expected and basic blanks are reported
Tier_C_condition: Known absorbance, autofluorescence, quenching, precipitation, or aggregation is uncontrolled
rationale: Fluorescence artifacts can mimic protection or loss
example: Carotenoid inner-filter effect requires explicit QC

Tier_A_requirement: Primary paper, exact table/figure/supplement, DOI/PMID, and protocol source are traceable
Tier_B_requirement: Primary paper is traceable but exact result location is incomplete
Tier_C_condition: Only a secondary quotation or database value lacking primary provenance is available
example: Value traced to a supplemental table

Tier_A_requirement: Independent experiment and cohort of measurements are identifiable
Tier_B_requirement: Possible overlap is disclosed and only one record is retained in aggregation
Tier_C_condition: Duplicate publication is counted as independent evidence
rationale: Repeated reporting must not inflate confidence
example: Conference abstract and later paper counted once
